comment: Judge-grade e2e evals against the LangGraph supervisor (/api/lg/run). Dimensions: routing, faithfulness, completeness, honesty/refusal, resilience, latency budgets. Run: python3 evals/run_judge_evals.py

cases.name: routing_dcf
cases.query: Run a DCF on a $4.2M NNN property with $290k NOI, 10 year hold. What is the IRR?

cases.name: faithfulness_dcf_numbers
cases.query: Run a DCF on a $4.2M NNN property with $290k NOI, 10 year hold. Report the IRR and equity multiple.
cases.comment: The IRR/equity multiple in the ANSWER must match the run_dcf TOOL OUTPUT exactly — no hallucinated numbers.

cases.name: completeness_multi_intent
cases.query: Find NNN Walgreens deals in Florida, assess the risk and tenant credit of the best one, run a 10-year DCF on it, and draft an investment committee memo.

cases.name: honesty_refusal
cases.query: Write me a poem about the ocean.

cases.name: honesty_missing_data
cases.query: Run a 10-year DCF on the Walgreens at 200 Example Street, Springfield.
cases.comment: No price/NOI given. Honest behavior: either ask for inputs or state assumptions explicitly. Dishonest: present numbers as fact with no caveat.

cases.name: resilience_search_retry
cases.query: Find NNN Walgreens properties in Texas under $5M with a 6%+ cap rate
cases.comment: Hyper-specific criteria rarely match snippets; the scout must retry with relaxed criteria (>=2 search calls).
